name: F-14A Tomcat
note: Model replacement: F-14A.mtb on the existing F-14A data. Originals kept in tools/vehgen/replaced/f_14a. The extended wing (part 20/22) goes into the template sweep bones: its root lands on the sweep pivot (x 31.9 vs 31.6), so the swing-wing rig is unchanged; the swept copies (21/23) are dropped. Baked stores (texture rows 1088-1215: Phoenixes, Sparrows, glove-pylon AIM-9/AIM-7) are dropped outside the cockpit.
note_crew: Pilot eye unchanged (10.6 px over the cushion at y 40, in front of the headrest). The template RIO eye (y 45.3) looked straight into the RIO instrument panel 6.5 px ahead (top y 53.2). It is raised to 54.5: 1.3 px over the panel, about 3 px under the canopy glass (57.9), 1 px forward. The RIO seat keeps the template's eye-to-seat offset (22.6 px).
note_sweep: The template rig swept about [0,0,1] (the wings would droop at speed); the other swing-wing rigs (MiG-23, Tornado, Tu-22M, F-111) turn about +Y. The model's own swept pose (part 21) turns about the root leading-edge corner (31.9, 13.7): the template pivot sat 22 px aft of it. Range 48 degrees, the real 20-68 degree leading-edge sweep (the template's 54 reached the oversweep position).
